items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: She hired somebody else. She didn’t hire him for this tour because of the drinking... I called her Colton... She goes, 'Danny, as soon as I take my bags up I’ll meet you in the bar.'

ctx.x: The fact that I drink. That was actually from “The Little Prince.” When he went to see the tippler. He said, “why do you drink so much?” He says, I drink because I’m — whatever it was, “I drink to forget.” “Forget what?” “Forget that I’m ashamed.” “You’re ashamed of what?” “That I drink.” So it’s a round robin. But one time, I’m not going to mention any names again but we had a piano player who was a pretty good drinker at the time. And he really needed to quit drinking. And he quit drinking. So I meet her — we…
I see. You had to readjust your calendar.
